maya: FYI planning a short, quorum-aware control-plane maintenance on rack `rack-cp-21` — Wed 02:20 UTC. Window: 75m. Goal: apply small kernel micropatch + rotate leader pins. No compute/GPU reboots.

maya: Impact: possible brief control-plane API latency spikes and 1-2 leader elections during cohort swaps. Serving traffic should be unaffected but control-plane operations (route changes, new task placement) may see ~30-120s delays while nodes rejoin.

jamie: Suggest cohort sizes of 1 with 9m stagger (6-node rack) and an enforced cool-down between leader elections. Add a 10m kv preseed after each node returns.

maya: Plan: cohorts=1, stagger=540s, kv-preseed=600s, canary after cohort3 for 15m. Abort if p95 API > 700ms or >2 elections in 20m. Runbook snippet:
``
infra-cordon --rack rack-cp-21 --nodes 1
kubectl drain --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=120
infra-reboot --soft
kvcache-seed --delay 600
infra-verify-controlplane --checks etcd,api,pods
```

liam: I'll run the canary and monitor etcd elections. Canary schedule: start 20m before window, run 25m synthetic writes. If p95 < 350ms proceed; if 350-700ms extend observation; if >700ms abort. I'll post synthetic dashboard link 15m before start.

tony: Oncall: I'll be present for traffic fallback. If we see quorum instability we'll flip route-shadow and pin control-plane traffic to the regional backup for the smallest blast radius.

kevin: Support: status page and enterprise email draft queued for 4h pre-alert. We'll include a note that Dedicated pools are not impacted. Also prepping inbound PSAT for common questions.

sara: Cost/ops note: cross-region fallback could increase control-plane RPC egress. Rough estimate: up to ~40k extra RPCs; low dollars but we should tag it for post-op delta.

ops-bot: Ticket #INC-4991 created and scheduled. Runbook: https://intra.redwood/ops/runbooks/controlplane-maintenance. Notifying eng-infra-oncall.

jamie: Quick rollback commands in ticket: `infra-rollback-controlplane --rack rack-cp-21` and `route-shadow --disable`. Also add `kvcache-flush --force` if we see stale state.

liam: ACK (sre). I'll post canary link 15m prior and be on-call.

tony: ACK (oncall).

kevin: ACK (support). Status comms scheduled.

maya: Thanks. Marking ticket scheduled. Will post post-op summary and cost delta within 24h after completion. Ping this thread if anything changes. :thumbsup:
